ValidationRule.description: US and CA addresses require the STate for Sovos to calculate tax properly
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( CONTAINS($User.Username, 'loads.user') = false, CONTAINS($User.Username, 'ivan') = false, IsPersonAccount = false, Potential__c = false, OR( ISPICKVAL(BillingCountryCode, 'US'), ISPICKVAL(BillingCountryCode, 'CA') ), ISPICKVAL(BillingStateCode, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: State required for US and Canada accounts
